note: Lane sleeve_backtests (wave 6): the sleeves' on-demand research backtests (swing, VBT, options). Each run appends one *_backtest_run row; started_at is the injected clock's first second on both sides, finished_at advances with real elapsed time (compared <null>/<set>), created_at is Postgres now() (stamp), and error carries Python's traceback or Rust's origin line (compared <null>/<set>; the payload compares the class and message). The bed holds bars 2017-01-02..2026-10-29; windows are kept short so a case is minutes, not the nine-year run.

cases.name: vbt-window-friday-in-session
cases.note: a Friday inside the session: three books over one detection pass, one row with stats and drift

cases.name: vbt-end-defaults-to-today-saturday
cases.note: positional start; end is date.today() (UTC under TZ=UTC) on a non-trading Saturday morning, past the last bar

cases.name: vbt-before-session-start-empty-string
cases.note: an empty start is falsy, so DEFAULT_START (2017-10-16); a short history with the warm-up starting before the first bar

cases.name: vbt-no-bars-in-window-after-close
cases.note: ValueError after the row is inserted: run_in_session rolls it back, the identity sequence remembers it

cases.name: vbt-two-sessions-nan-stats
cases.note: two sessions: the books summarise with a NaN (no variance), json.dumps writes the bare NaN token and Postgres refuses it; Python raises DBAPIError (its message carries SQLAlchemy's SQL and parameter dump, masked), the whole run rolls back, only the identity sequence moves

cases.name: options-tier1-o3b-event-day-saturday
cases.seed_sql: INSERT INTO op_event_day (user_id, date, reason, source) VALUES (1, DATE '2026-10-27', 'MANUAL', 'USER');
cases.note: positional args, date_to omitted (today, a Saturday): the tenant's event day is skipped as EVENT_DAY, never a signal

cases.name: options-tier1-withdrawn-expiry-before-open

cases.note: every expiry from the window on is withdrawn: the master no longer calendars those days, so they are counted uncalendared, never guessed
